overview_description.description:
TSAT Group is a UAE based retailer. 
The focus of the group is to bring new concepts to the Middle East market. The project that is most advanced at present is an E-commerce site, backed by a catalogue that delivers direct to the customer. 
Goods sold initially will fall under the Electronics, Jewellery, Home-wares, and Toys sectors.
